title: VTC Rooms — Storage — Migrate — payload
description: Move a hosted room's existing blobs onto its assigned storage config: copy, verify against the manifest, switch, orphan the old copy. Orphaned blobs are not moved. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

roomId.description: The room's identifier, as its owner minted it.

maxBytesPerSecond.description: Upper bound on the copy rate. The community applies its own lower bound when absent or larger.

reason.description: Why the administrator is making this change. Recorded with the change in the audit trail and shown to approvers. Attributed to its author on every surface and untrusted: it MUST NOT carry personal data or a credential, and a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.

Response.title: VTC Rooms — Storage — Migrate — response payload

migrationId.description: Community-generated handle for this room's migration.

roomId.description: The room's identifier, as its owner minted it.

toConfig.description: The config this migration moves blobs to: the room's assigned config when the migration was approved. It does not change if the room is reassigned while the migration is under way.

lastError.description: Present when `state` is `paused`; MAY be present while `running`, when a step is being retried.

nextAttemptAt.description: When the community will next try by itself. Present while a `running` migration waits out a backoff, and on a `paused` one the community will retry unprompted; absent on a `paused` one only re-issuing vtc/rooms/storage/migrate resumes (such as `capacity`).
